paragraphs: Explainable Multimodal AI & Deep Ordinal Staging for Knee Osteoarthritis

KneeVision++ is an end-to-end multimodal deep learning and clinical reasoning framework designed for severity grading of knee osteoarthritis (OA) according to the Kellgren–Lawrence (KL grades 0–4) ordinal staging scale.
features: Ordinal Computer Vision: Consistent Rank Logits (CORAL) on DenseNet121 with continuous soft cumulative targets and MixUp data regularization, yielding state-of-the-art ordinal concordance while eliminating extreme…

Explainable AI (XAI): Native, mathematically calibrated visual explanation maps (Grad-CAM, Score-CAM, and LIME) blended with source radiographs to illuminate joint space narrowing and marginal osteophytes.
Clinical Natural Language Processing: Fine-tuned BioClinicalBERT encoding patient demographics, symptom scores (WOMAC), and semi-quantitative OARSI radiographic assessments.
Multimodal Late Fusion: A joint multimodal neural architecture combining 1024-dimensional visual features with 768-dimensional clinical language representations.
